summary: KB Financial Group filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026 announcing its 2026 third quarter earnings conference, scheduled for Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 16:00 Korea time. The event will be a live webcast and conference call in Korean and English, with simultaneous English interpretation. The agenda covers third quarter earnings results and a Q&A session, accessible via overseas dial-in 82-31-810-3128 or domestic 031-810-3128, passcode 6412#, Q&A code *1. No transaction, stake, price, or advisory terms are disclosed. This is a routine earnings-notice filing with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
